cards.card1: OA Sports is a multidisciplinary sports consulting and management firm that brings together diverse expertise under one roof.
cards.card2: Our mission is to accompany professionals at all levels of sport, players, coaches, referees, clubs, and federations in building sustainable success through effective, long-term strategies.
cards.card3: Every service we offer is meticulously designed to add value to your career and help you reach the top.

card1.title: Years of Industry Experience
card1.text: In-depth experience gained in the global dynamics of football, focusing on strategy, 360° performance analysis, and career management.

card2.title: Partner
card2.text: Core team specializing in performance analysis, sports science, scouting, data analytics, and mental support, providing 360° service.

card3.title: Global Connection Point
card3.text: More than 42 strong and active international relationships established across different continents for elite-level career management, squad planning, and strategic collaborations.

card1.title: For Players
card1.text: We provide comprehensive career consulting, performance development, and representation support to help transform your potential into performance—and your performance into a lasting career.

card2.title: For Coaches
card2.text: We partner in your career planning and professional growth, delivering technical development and guidance.

card3.title: For Referees
card3.text: We offer all the professional support needed for an elite-level career through development-focused advisory services.

card4.title: For Teams and Professionals
card4.text: We add vision to ambition-driven clubs with squad planning, scouting, and recruitment services.

card5.title: For Federations
card5.text: We support fair and high-quality competition with referee consultancy and training solutions.

card1.title: Interdisciplinary Expert Team
card1.text: The strength of OA Sports comes from its interdisciplinary team that approaches sports from every angle. With our expert staff built on four main pillars, we secure your future.

card2.title: Management & Strategy Team
card2.text: We shape your long-term career roadmap and define your vision. With strategic guidance in representation, negotiation processes, and contract management, we open the path ahead of you.

card3.title: Technical & Tactical Team
card3.text: We provide specialized analyses, on-field development plans, and technical guidance to enhance your performance.

card4.title: Scouting, Analysis & Recruitment Team
card4.text: We match talent with the right opportunities using data-driven systems.

card5.title: Medical, Health & Sports Science Team
card5.text: We reduce injury risk, improve performance, and provide personalized preparation support.

card6.title: A 360° Perspective
card6.text: This holistic approach helps you find a strategic partner dedicated to your career and delivers the most accurate and reliable solutions to your needs.

card1.title: Match Analysis
card1.text: Detailed reports to help players and teams understand performance, improve decisions, and build better strategies.

card2.title: Career Strategy
card2.text: We guide athletes step by step with professional planning, long-term goals, and clear development paths.

card3.title: Performance Support
card3.text: Improve your physical, technical, and mental performance with expert support designed for modern football.

card4.title: Club Consulting
card4.text: Smart consulting solutions for clubs, academies, and federations to grow stronger and work more professionally.

section.description1: OA Sports proudly collaborates with SBU University to create new opportunities for athletes, students, and sports professionals through innovation, education, and strategic development.
section.description2: This partnership combines academic excellence with real-world sports expertise to support the next generation of talent and build a stronger future for modern sports.

tabs.tab1: What Do These Services Bring You?
tabs.tab6: Become the Architect of Your Career

card1.title: Strategic Advantage in Every Match
card1.text: With detailed opponent analysis and tactical match plans, you read the game before it even starts—at player, coach, referee, club, and federation levels—stepping onto the field one step ahead.

card2.title: Performance Analysis
card2.text: With video and data-supported performance analysis, GPS statistics, and tactical and physical evaluations, you measure both individual and team performance, tracking your progress with concrete reports.

card3.title: Squad Planning
card3.text: For clubs, squad planning, transfer strategy, and scouting services match the right player with the right system and budget; achieving sustainable sporting success and financial balance.

card4.title: Referee Consultancy
card4.text: Custom-designed referee analysis, training programs, and match management consultancy for referees and federations elevate your league's level of fairness, decision consistency, and brand value.

card5.title: Continuous Digital Support
card5.text: With an expert team accessible throughout the season, you access all analyses and reports via a dedicated digital panel; experiencing continuous partnership supported by privacy and data security.
